name: a-failed-rebuild-keeps-its-reason
find:
graphics.failDayRegen(
                        day, for: event.id,
                        reason: "\(day.displayName) audio swap failed: "
                              + "\(error.localizedDescription)")
replace:
graphics.endDayRegen(day, for: event.id)
                    pickError = "\(day.displayName) audio swap failed: \(error.localizedDescription)"
breaks: the audio swap's failure goes back into the screen's own state, which dies with the screen while the run does not, so a swap that failed after Dan moved to another event leaves nothing behind and any other action's failure overwrites this one (#721, L53, L148)
